claim: DSPy RLM Topic-node ten-case synthetic integration smoke

judge.method: Pinned official prompts and Chat Completions settings, strict verdict parser with official substring verdict also recorded; explicit failed-attempt scoring

policy.preparation: Fresh isolated history per case and arm. LLGM imports supplied sessions through conservative topic routing with immutable per-turn attribution and generic connections. No question or gold during construction. Query uses remember=False. Baselines import original sessions without model organization.
policy.comparison: Current topic construction has no hosted measurement. Earlier session-per-node measurements do not establish this behavior. Match models and budgets before architecture claims.
policy.exposure: LongMemEval-S contains overlapping histories and previously exposed diagnostic questions. This is a public benchmark result, not an untouched independent holdout.
policy.target: Five percentage points over strongest reproduced framework at no higher total cost remains the goal. These initial control arms alone do not compare Mem0 or Graphiti.
policy.cost: Generation includes maintenance, query and unknown call liabilities. Judge costs separate. Token-based API estimates are not invoices. Local resources reported but unpriced, so equal total cost is unestablished.
policy.execution: All scheduled attempts retained with no answer retries. Existing generation and judge allowances remain admission limits. Full benchmark execution is separate explicit work.
